non_generalization_policy: Contour A (Voice) and Contour B (Stems) are strictly separate feasibility evaluations and must not be generalized to stereo music mastering (Preserve).

go_no_go_1_voice.rationale: CPU WPE + spectral speech enhancement baselines validate the evaluation harness with positive SI-SDRi on reverberant/noisy synthetic speech and 0.0 error on clean voice negative controls, but production adoption is NO-GO because: (1) real speech corpora (DAPS, VoiceBank+DEMAND) are not provisioned on host, (2) neural speech models (DeepFilterNet3, SGMSE+, Flow) and DNSMOS are blocked pending authorized Colab GPU + checkpoint audit, (3) PESQ requires explicit license clearance, and (4) speech enhancement must never be generalized to stereo music Preserve.
decision_inputs_for_colab_voice_stage: Provision licensed DAPS and VoiceBank+DEMAND dev splits with speaker-disjoint manifests and SHA-256 pins.
Authorize Google Colab GPU session (separate ticket) with pinned DeepFilterNet3 (MIT/Apache-2.0) and SGMSE+ (MIT) checkpoints.
Clear ITU-T P.862 license for PESQ or standardize on open-licensed DNSMOS P.835 + Whisper WER / phoneme-drop hallucination checks.
Require >= +3.0 dB SI-SDRi and positive STOI/DNSMOS gain over CPU WPE+Wiener on DAPS/VoiceBank with 0 regressions on clean anechoic controls.
Keep any future voice profile strictly isolated from Preserve stereo music mastering (separate opt-in voice route only after product approval).

go_no_go_2_stems.non_generalization_warning: STRICT BOUNDARY: Neither Contour A (Voice) nor Contour B (Stems) results may be generalized to stereo music mastering (`Preserve` hard-declipping). Stem separation and re-summing introduces inter-stem bleed and phase/masking artifacts incompatible with Preserve's untouched-outside-mask stereo fidelity contract.
go_no_go_2_stems.rationale: The 4-stem CPU harness verifies exact additive mix integrity (`mix == sum(stems)`), shows deterministic HPSS+band separation improves over identity while trailing the Oracle IRM upper bound, and exposes OOD collapse when vocal/other spectra clash or stereo cues vanish (mono collapse). Production stem restoration is NO-GO because: (1) neural stem separators (HTDemucs, SCNet, BS-RoFormer) are blocked pending authorized Colab GPU + checkpoint license verification, (2) MUSDB18-HQ is not provisioned on host, and (3) stem separation is outside the Preserve stereo release.
decision_inputs_for_colab_stems_stage: Provision licensed MUSDB18-HQ dev split (non-commercial research check) with SHA-256 manifest.
Authorize Google Colab T4/L4 GPU session (separate ticket) with pinned HTDemucs v4 (MIT), SCNet (MIT), and license-verified BS-RoFormer checkpoints.
Measure per-stem SI-SDR, inter-stem leakage (dB), and exact mix reconstruction error (`sum(est_stems) - mix`) on both dev-e8-stems-v1 and MUSDB18-HQ.
Audit stereo phase/IPD preservation and bleed-through artifacts before any opt-in Enhance stem-repair prototype is proposed.
Do NOT route stereo mastering (`Preserve`) through stem separation or generalize stem SI-SDR to full-mix hard-declipping.
